--- Page 1 (Beckerman_16a) --- Dear Jack, Because your last week's letter made such a hurry-up job getting here, things are a bit more drawn out now, so we have to set out now with out one of your letters in front of us! I trust though that all's well, just as if we had the words down in black and white. About the same is true for here. Papa is working, plus some overtime but was minus one day's work this week as a small scale strike was called to persuade "higher ups" that they needed one week's vacation per year, with pay. Request: granted. The controversy over the 'House Problem' will reach a climax in the special meeting called for tomorrow when a vote will be taken on "Shall we keep our houses and run them as we have for the past 18 yrs. -- or will we give them up to the mortgage company". The first proposal seems the best of course but it entails raising rents to pay off BX. -- and there are evident prejudices of both sides with many arguments. Here's one piece of news you may be glad to get: We've finally managed to get one record sent off to you. It's one from a Duke Ellington --- Page 2 (Beckerman_16b) --- album, but it will be nothing less than a solid miracle if it arrives in one piece. I'm going to send off just one more of the set, on which a slightly better packing job was done, and we'll see how records take to shipping. The post office was still very touchy about the size of the thing - the clerk took out a whole set of rules + regulations, & finally let it go through under the clause saying "official equipment is exempt from any size guarantee" - so between us you're receiving official equipment! Mail from Abe is getting down to its regular schedule, and his last letter confirms also the thought that you will probably be headed this way before long.... He and the search for a camera again - this time for Abe, he has broken his. That however shouldn't hold up any pictures of you together as yours published serve the purpose equally well! We'll cut this short tonight as there's not much more to write of except Love & Regards Mama Papa Ruth
